scope: Ten case contracts, full language/policy/target route matrix and no-spend paired authoring-study specification; no implementations, benchmarks or trials claimed.

blocker_definitions.cgx2_source_ownership: Complete intended source ownership acceptance, not a claim of language inferiority.
blocker_definitions.cgx2_package_integration: T3 standalone native CPU ATen is ready, but authenticated CGx2 SDK/source/executable closure is unproven.
blocker_definitions.cgx2_notebook_effects: Complete persistent external-effect notebook integration remains unaccepted.
blocker_definitions.torch_gpu_backend: Installed Torch2.11.0+cpu has no HIP/CUDA backend; native LibTorch GPU and tensor device routes are blocked despite Vulkan smoke.
blocker_definitions.native_ml_binding: Rust/OCaml bindings to the pinned equivalent ATen facade/closure have not been supplied/validated for this suite.
blocker_definitions.gpu_binding: Language-specific binding to the common pinned Vulkan shader/ownership/completion contract has not been supplied/validated.
blocker_definitions.study_execution: No model/human trials, task starter/test freezing or external spend authorization for trials at this checkpoint.

policy_definitions.functional-v1: Exact common outputs/errors/effect/lifetime requirements per case; idiomatic allocator/collector behavior observed without granting equivalent guarded-memory policy.
policy_definitions.logical-policy-v1: Equipped modes add the same explicitly scoped logical policy heap/credit ledger, roots/handle validity, failure trace and foreign-call boundary. Logical credits are representation-independent experimental policy units, not native allocation bytes or RSS. Native CGx2 no_gc charges and each host runtime allocator/GC remain separately observed; equal native-byte policy requires additional reviewed equivalence, never per-language normalization after results.
policy_definitions.idiomatic: Ordinary libraries/runtime with common functional behavior; report policy-specific negative tests inapplicable rather than crediting a guard guarantee.
policy_definitions.equipped: All policy adapter/arena/collector/root/error/foreign-wrapper implementation and execution costs included. Rust without tracing GC already avoids tracing pauses. OCaml/Python may use preallocated/offheap/explicit policy heaps where justified; suppressing one collector alone does not prove no allocation, refcount activity or global pause freedom.

execution_gates: Independently accept common functional+failure contract for each comparable pair.
Audit equipped-policy scope and logical/native accounting; incompatible contracts stay blocked.
Run pilots on quiet host after setup; preregister practical thresholds before holdout.
Only then run immutable holdout; preserve errors, failures and uncertainty.

cases.name: Owned-buffer pipeline

behavior.algorithm: Allocate fresh u8 buffer x[i]=(17*i+3)%256; move it into stage; replace each byte with (3*x[i]+1)%256; return sum as checked i64 and first/last byte (null when empty).
behavior.observables: One logical owner after move, no implicit whole-buffer copy; returned view must not outlive owner.

errors.expected: InputError, no payload allocation
AllocationError, no published owner; release prior temporaries once

dtype.storage: signed i64 unless bytes explicitly u8
dtype.arithmetic: checked i64; overflow is ArithmeticError before publishing that operation

cases.cost_boundary: Include allocate/fill/move/transform/checksum/drop; instrument copied payload bytes and actual capacities. Exclude source build from warm run; report build and cold launch separately.
cases.aliasing_lifetime: Source owner moves exactly once; backing identity preserved across stage; no required physical pointer equality across languages.
acceptance_tests: Independent byte/checksum oracle for every n.
Use-after-move and escaping-view source/API negatives; runtime languages need equivalent checked wrapper in equipped mode.
Injected construction failure cleanup; no signal/timeout accepted as expected failure.

cases.name: Managed object graph with cycles and roots

behavior.algorithm: Create nodes 0..n-1 with value=i. For i<n-1 link i->i+1; link n-1->0; add roots at 0 and n//2. Trace/checksum all reachable nodes once. Remove both roots and explicitly collect.
behavior.observables: Before unroot: n live nodes and checksum n*(n-1)/2; after collect: zero live policy-heap nodes; old handles invalid.
behavior.additional: A second fixture is reverse slot-order chain with a root at the highest slot; preserve same reachable set.

errors.expected: InvalidHandle

errors.condition: link object in region A to B
errors.expected: CrossRegionEdge, graph unchanged

errors.condition: injected reserve/region failure before node publication
errors.expected: AllocationError; previous graph and roots preserved; diagnostics may change

dtype.storage: signed i64 unless bytes explicitly u8
dtype.arithmetic: checked i64; overflow is ArithmeticError before publishing that operation

cases.cost_boundary: Include graph build/root registration/traversal/unroot/collection and retain separate phase metrics. Count S physical slots, V reachable nodes, E stored edge positions, passes, inspected slots/edges and sweep work. Include equivalent root/collector implementation effort.
cases.aliasing_lifetime: Cycles/aliases preserved; checksum visits identities once, not paths; handles validated by generation/occupancy; policy heap scope explicit.
acceptance_tests: Known reachable/unreachable graph oracle.
Stale handle, duplicate roots, cross-region and fault traces.
S/V/E conservation and exactly-once node cleanup; no timing credit from changing graph shape.

cases.name: Guarded mixed lifecycle and nested budget failure

behavior.algorithm: In logical-policy-v1 ledger: outer budget256; establish object A charge16; inner budget64; establish B charge32; request C charge40 (reject); request collect in either region (reject); leave inner; establish D charge24; leave outer; explicitly collect unreachable nodes.
behavior.observables: Successful cumulative outer spend72 and inner spend32; C absent; prior A/B payloads unchanged; no collection event while guarded; one rejected allocation plus one forbidden-collection event; rooted survivors remain valid.
behavior.native_accounting: These numbers are logical payload credits, never substituted for CGx2 native guard-byte values. Record native capacity/metadata charges independently; native byte-contract equality requires separately reviewed mapping.

errors.expected: BudgetExceeded without C/charge commit; allowed diagnostics recorded

errors.condition: collect in either region under guard
errors.expected: CollectionForbidden
GuardEntryError/AllocationError; existing guards/roots preserved; prior successful charges not refunded

dtype.storage: signed i64 unless bytes explicitly u8
dtype.arithmetic: checked i64; overflow is ArithmeticError before publishing that operation

cases.cost_boundary: Include policy wrappers, guard/root bookkeeping, allocation preflight, failed attempts, cleanup and collection after exit. Report logical credits and actual runtime charges in separate columns; include language runtime pauses in wall time.
cases.aliasing_lifetime: A/B survive rejected C; owner/root transfer and lexical cleanup audited. No requirement of whole-state equality: diagnostics/fault observations may change.
acceptance_tests: Exact logical admission/event trace.
Native guard entry/exit/failure trace with derived target-specific capacity charges.
Unknown foreign call inside strict guard rejects; no foreign work is timed inside it.
Normal/error/unwind cleanup; cancellation separately admitted or blocked.

cases.name: Foreign copy/transfer and alias lifetime

behavior.algorithm: Input contiguous f32 [1,-2,3,4] repeated k times. Foreign operation returns a fresh contiguous output equal to input*2; source remains unchanged. Returned borrowed view aliases output until output release.
behavior.transfers: CPU path measures CGx2/host-to-ATen copies. GPU path additionally includes host-to-device and device-to-host copies and completion; no zero-copy claim without alias/lifetime observation.

inputs.strict_guard: foreign call excluded unless separately justified explicit contract

errors.expected: DTypeError/LayoutError before foreign invocation; no silent copy
AllocationError, input unchanged, no output handle leak
checked wrapper InvalidHandle, not undefined native access

dtype.arithmetic: float32 multiply/add; fixed backend/threads/device; no autocast or TF32; float64 independent oracle

cases.cost_boundary: Include facade loading/amortization, binding/validation, all host/device copies, output ownership/view tracking, completion and releases. Report copied bytes and allocated/reserved host/device bytes separately from logical credits.
cases.aliasing_lifetime: Output storage is independent of input; view aliases output only; release ordering and exact once handle destruction observed. Kernel asynchronous lifetime separate from host Session.
acceptance_tests: Input immutability, output alias/view changes and cleanup oracle.
Wrong-type/layout failures, injected reserve failure and stale-view wrapper error.
Actual backend+copy count+sync trace; no foreign call admitted under strict guard solely by annotation.

cells.C1: read input [1,2,3] once and set x
cells.C2: set y=[2*v+1 for v in x]; no external write
cells.C3: append sum(y) to an external event file and display it

cases.name: Explicit device affine kernel with synchronized readback

behavior.algorithm: Two separate kernels: i32 y=2*x+1 for x[i]=(i%17)-8; f32 y=2*x for x[i]=((i%17)-8)/8. Workgroup64; dispatch ceil(n/64); bounds guard i<n.
behavior.outputs: Exact i32/f32 dyadic results; n=0 skips dispatch and returns empty.
behavior.backend: Pin one WGSL/Vulkan compute implementation/adapter for every admitted language binding; never compare a Vulkan shader to a different tensor kernel as a language effect.

inputs.adapter: AMD discrete PCI1002:7550 RX9070XT, Vulkan; reject iGPU/llvmpipe/CPU fallback

InputError before device allocation

dtype.arithmetic: i32 domain cannot overflow; f32 dyadic multiplication exact
dtype.tolerance: exact; reject NaN/infinity; same shader bytes

cases.cost_boundary: Include host allocation/fill, upload, shader/pipeline cold compile, dispatch, queue completion, readback and buffer release; kernel-only timing optional separate. Pin Mesa26.2.4 testing/non-conformant warning and actual adapter; do not call production-ready.
cases.aliasing_lifetime: Host/device buffer owners remain alive through completion; copied transfer counts explicit; no host Session theorem for asynchronous GPU memory.
acceptance_tests: Every element checked independently after explicit synchronization/readback.
Adapter/vendor/device/API and shader hash recorded.
Buffer lifetime/failure cases separate from environment smoke and no timing during setup.

study.failure_scoring: Charge unsuccessful attempt its full assigned token/time budget in all-task cost-to-success; retain actual observed usage separately; never fabricate actual consumption.
study.design: Paired same task/model family/replicate across languages; block by family/policy/difficulty, randomize language order with frozen seed and counterbalance presentation. Independent assessors receive pseudonymous submissions and sealed tests; honest language blinding is partial because syntax is recognizable.
study.leakage: Separate task authors, reference solutions and hidden tests from trial workspaces. No future git history, sibling-language solutions, held-out failures, private grading source or cross-attempt conversation. Equal public docs/tool/dependency/context budgets. Publish retired tasks only after evaluation.
study.thresholds: No numerical superiority gate selected here. Pilots inform noise/effect size/power and practical thresholds; preregister before holdout and report uncertainty with task-clustered paired analysis. Historical design targets remain proposed, not met or silently reused as calibrated thresholds.

cost_proposal.formula: attempts*(0.060*input_rate_per_million+0.012*output_rate_per_million); multiply by1.25 reserve. Rates are assumed procurement ceilings; require current written quotes/frozen model versions and explicit spend choice before trials.
exclusions: model rate higher than assumed ceiling
cost_proposal.resources: Local CPU tests initially; GPU trials blocked until pinned backend acceptance. Models from at least2 families fitting selected ceiling; no model IDs/prices asserted current. Independent human panel and acceptance review need separate availability/cost proposal.
